audience: domain owners and IT teams who manage domains and DNS at Realtime Register

useCases.title: Check whether a domain name is available
useCases.text: Check one domain name for availability and its premium price, if it has one. Read the TLD rules for the fields that registry needs.

useCases.title: Review domains and their expiry dates
useCases.text: List the domains in the account with expiry dates, name servers and status. Open one domain for its contacts and auto-renew setting.

useCases.title: Read the DNS zone of a domain
useCases.text: Read the DNS zone that belongs to a domain, with its records and SOA settings. List all DNS zones of the account to find others.

useCases.title: Check the prepaid credit and name servers
useCases.text: Read the prepaid credit balance of the account. List the host objects with their name servers and glue addresses.

useCases.title: Change the records of a DNS zone
useCases.text: Read the zone first, then send only the records or settings you change. Then check the process that the update returns. Changes reach the public internet after DNS caches expire.
